name: Scroll Text
title: Scroll Text
description: A smooth, reversible scroll-driven text reveal with Fade, ASCII, and Mosaic effects.
summary: Reveal words through fading, resolving ASCII symbols, or dissolving mosaic blocks. Tune alignment, typography, color, opacity, stagger, smoothing, rise, and blur in Component Studio.
highlights: Fade, ASCII, and Mosaic reveals that unwind when scrolling back
Optional accent words, rise, and blur
Native page scrolling or a supplied scroll container
Live effect, typography, alignment, and motion controls
Fully readable server-rendered and reduced-motion fallback
Initializes after native scroll-container refs are attached
anatomy: <ScrollText> semantic paragraph with a complete accessible name
Whitespace-preserving visual word spans hidden from screen readers
A shared staggered timeline connected to one ScrollTrigger

physics.description: One staggered timeline maps scroll progress to word opacity and optional transforms. ASCII symbols resolve within fixed letter boxes; Mosaic tiles dissolve over the original words. Numeric scrub smooths both directions. A debounced ResizeObserver refreshes layout changes.

keyboard.description: Focus the named scroll region in the demo.

keyboard.key: Arrow Up / Arrow Down / Page Up / Page Down
keyboard.description: Scroll the demo using native browser controls.

accessibility.aria: The full paragraph is exposed once through aria-label; decorative word spans are hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.reducedMotion: All words remain fully visible. No scroll animation or blur is created; changing the preference at runtime reverts the animation.

recommended: Scroll-driven product stories and section copy
bestPractices: Use a readable foreground and accessible accent colors.
Give the paragraph enough scroll space before and after it to cover the configured range.
Pass a stable ref when using a nested native scroll container.
Keep rise and blur at zero for the reference opacity-only effect.
Use className or style for responsive typography and width.

props.name: text
props.description: The complete paragraph. Whitespace and line breaks are preserved.

props.name: highlightWords
props.description: Words to tint with the accent color. Matching ignores case and surrounding punctuation.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Inherits the surrounding foreground by default.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Scroll catch-up duration in seconds, clamped to 0–2. Zero tracks scroll directly.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Spacing between word reveals on the shared timeline, clamped to 0.01–1.

props.name: rise
props.description: Optional initial vertical offset in pixels, clamped to 0–40.

props.name: blur
props.description: Optional initial blur in pixels, clamped to 0–12. Zero avoids filter animation.

props.name: effect
props.description: Reveal style. ASCII resolves symbols into letters; Mosaic dissolves a grid of blocks into words. All modes reverse with scroll.

props.name: start
props.description: ScrollTrigger start position relative to the viewport or supplied scroller.

props.name: end
props.description: ScrollTrigger end position. Leave enough scroll space after the paragraph to reach it.

props.name: scroller
props.description: Optional native scroll container ref. Uses page scrolling when omitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional paragraph classes, including responsive typography and maximum width.

props.name: style
props.description: Custom typography, dimensions, and inline paragraph styles.
